children: South Africa's economy shrank by 0.2% over a quarter in Q2 2026, following a downwardly revised 0.4% expansion in Q1 and more than the expected 0.1% decline.
This marked the first economic downturn since Q3 2024, snapping its longest quarterly growth run in almost a decade, amid the fallout from the Middle East conflict.
Three of the ten industries contracted, with trade, catering and accommodation industry down 1.9%, while energy-intensive manufacturing and mining fell 1.8% and 3.0%, respectively.
Agriculture, however, provided some cushion, growing 0.3% on stronger activity in horticulture and field crops.
On a yearly basis, the GDP rose by 0.9% in Q2, marking a sharp slowdown from 1.9% in Q1 and missing the 1% growth expected by markets.

title: South Africa Economy Contracts More than Expected
